tests.description: Reference: WRF 4.8 em_scm_xy single-column run at chem_opt = 170 with Noah (sf_surface_physics = 2, num_soil_layers = 4, silt loam, dryland cropland, slopetyp 1), data/eqwefic/chem170_scm, dumped by ctessum-claude/WRF branch earthsciml-instrumented-chem170 and replayed through the real64 (-fdefault-real-8) kernels/noah_driver. Inputs are the dumped SFLX arguments (real32 values widened). The column is unfrozen and unsaturated at every dumped step, so the frozen-ground infiltration reduction fcr and SSTEP's supersaturation redistribution are UNTESTED, not merely unused, and so is every path that reads sice. INFILTRATION AND RUNOFF at pre-dawn, no rain: drainage and root uptake only. Reference at ESM_DT = 1e-4 s, which is NOT the smallest available and is chosen deliberately. WRF's infiltration limiter contains val = 1 - exp(-kdt dt/86400); as dt falls the argument underflows into the cancellation of 1 - exp(-x), and as dt rises val departs from its linear limit, so the replay's own accuracy is a V in dt. Measured on the step-601 column, the replay differs from this component by 5.8e-7 at dt = 1e-6, 1.1e-8 at dt = 1e-4 and 2.2e-5 at dt = 1, with a clean minimum at 1e-4; the runoff1 tolerance below is set from that floor and bounds the REFERENCE, not the component. runoff2 contains no dt-dependent quantity at all and is pinned at 1e-9.

Reference: WRF 4.8 em_scm_xy single-column run at chem_opt = 170 with Noah (sf_surface_physics = 2, num_soil_layers = 4, silt loam, dryland cropland, slopetyp 1), data/eqwefic/chem170_scm, dumped by ctessum-claude/WRF branch earthsciml-instrumented-chem170 and replayed through the real64 (-fdefault-real-8) kernels/noah_driver. Inputs are the dumped SFLX arguments (real32 values widened). The column is unfrozen and unsaturated at every dumped step, so the frozen-ground infiltration reduction fcr and SSTEP's supersaturation redistribution are UNTESTED, not merely unused, and so is every path that reads sice. SOIL WATER AND CANOPY TENDENCIES at pre-dawn, no rain: drainage and root uptake only. SSTEP advances the soil column IN PLACE with an implicit tridiagonal solve, so WRF's dt = 60 s increment is not the instantaneous tendency; the reference is the replay increment at ESM_DT = 0.01 s. drip and dcmc_dt are referenced at the SAME step and not at a smaller one, because WRF forms drip as (cmc + dt rhsct) - cmcmax: the increment is nine orders below cmc at dt = 1e-6 and is destroyed by cancellation, while at 1e-2 it is recovered to 1e-11. The per-level assertions carry an ABSOLUTE bound: the reference's own implicit-solve truncation is about 1e-11 (1/s), which is a few times 1e-5 of the DEEPEST layer's tendency, so the quiet layers cannot be pinned relatively at this step size while the top layer is pinned to 1e-7 of its own amplitude.
